summary.text: Ife was the sacred city of the Yoruba, honoured by every crowned king. Its strength was reverence, not armies, and in the 19th-century wars it was sacked more than once.

arms.text: The cradle of the Yoruba: kings traced their crowns to Ife.

record.text: Ife joined Ijebu to destroy Owu in the Owu war.

reviewNotes: Arms levels (1 some, 2 a real strength, 3 famous for it) are the compiler’s judgement from the sources, for the Versus page’s guess; please check them.
